The structure of Zr16Nb8Au8 (reduced formula Zr2NbAu) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for Au, Nb, and Zr centers, each with eight geometric neighbors at 2.9564 Å: Au is coordinated by 4 Nb and 4 Zr, while Nb and Zr each have 8 Zr and 4 Au neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Au, Nb, and Zr 8-vertex coordination polyhedra.
